In the last 20 years firms that produce cameras have begun to produce fewer 35-mm cameras and more digital cameras. This trend is an example of
Option A: how central planners dictate which cameras are produced.
Option B: the market system answering the question of "how" cameras should be produced.
Option C: the market system answering the question of "what" cameras should be produced.
Option D: the market system answering the question of "who" should consume the cameras that are produced.
